Stop Watching Start Growing.Join Tenacity Academy

That job you hate does NOT have to be your forever.

If you wake up every morning dreading going to work, watching the clock, feeling underpaid, overlooked, and knowing deep down you want MORE…

**A cleaning business could become your EXIT PLAN.**

And no, I’m not telling you to walk into work tomorrow and quit.

I’m telling you to **BUILD YOUR WAY OUT.**

Start your cleaning business while you still have your paycheck.

Learn how to price.
Learn how to get clients.
Go after recurring contracts.
Build your systems.
Hire the right people.
Stack your revenue.

Then work toward the day when your business income gives you the OPTION to leave that job.

I built a cleaning company that generated over **$2 MILLION in revenue in 5 years.**

I made mistakes.
I lost money.
I learned some expensive lessons.

But I also learned what it takes to build a real cleaning business.

So if you're sitting at work thinking…

**“I KNOW I wasn't put on this earth just to clock in here every day.”**

Stop just dreaming about leaving.

**Start building your exit plan.**

If you're serious about starting or growing your cleaning business and you want to see how we can help you inside Tenacity Academy…

👇🏾 **COMMENT “DISCOVERY CALL” BELOW.**

We’ll reach out to you with the next steps.

**Your job might be paying the bills today.
Your business could be building your freedom tomorrow.**

🚨 **CLEANING BUSINESS OWNERS: BUILD A REFERRAL ARMY!**

Stop thinking YOU have to find every client yourself.

One of the smartest things you can do is build a **Referral Army** — people who already come in contact with your ideal clients and can send business your way.

Think about it:

🔥 Realtors
🔥 Property managers
🔥 Carpet cleaners
🔥 Junk removal companies
🔥 Pest control companies
🔥 Handymen & contractors
🔥 Moving companies
🔥 Restoration companies
🔥 Business consultants
🔥 Current & past clients

These people are already talking to businesses and homeowners who NEED cleaning services.

Build relationships. Refer business to THEM. Stay in contact. Give them something worth referring.

You don't need 1,000 people.

Imagine having **20–30 solid referral partners** who know exactly what you do and consistently keep your name in the room.

That's how you build a **REFERRAL ARMY.** 💰

Your next cleaning contract might not come from an ad.

**It might come from somebody who knows somebody.**

Start building your army. 🪖🔥

Want more strategies to start and grow your cleaning business? Join **Tenacity Academy** and become a Cleaning Business Warrior.

📬 **CLEANING BUSINESS OWNERS—SEND MAILERS… BUT NOT REGULAR MAILERS!**

Put a **company-branded PEN inside the envelope.** 🖊️😂

Why?

Because people will throw away a flyer in 2 seconds…

But when they feel something inside that envelope, they're opening that damn mail! 😂

Now your company name, phone number, and website are sitting on a pen they may actually KEEP and use.

Don't just send mail. **Give them a reason to OPEN IT and remember you.**

Commercial cleaning is about getting in fron

🚨 **CLEANING BUSINESS OWNERS—STOP LOOKING WHERE EVERYBODY ELSE IS LOOKING!**

Want commercial cleaning clients? **Target businesses that JUST opened.**

Go to your city/county website and look for **new business licenses**. Then check your local **Chamber of Commerce for upcoming ribbon cuttings.**

And here's the crazy part…

**GO TO THE DAMN RIBBON CUTTING! 😂**

Show up. Network. Meet the owner. Introduce your cleaning company.

Trust me—you might be the **ONLY janitorial company in the room** because everybody else is at home cold calling and running Google Ads. 😂

Work smarter. **Get in the room BEFORE they start looking for a cleaning company.**

🔥 Want more strategies like this? Join **Tenacity Academy** and become a Cleaning Business Warrior.

[www.tenacityacademy.com](http://www.tenacityacademy.com)

🎥 **VIDEO PROSPECTING STRATEGY**

Record a short video showing visible signs of cleaning neglect at a facility—dirty entrances, overflowing trash, stained floors, dusty areas, or neglected high-touch surfaces.

Send the video directly to the **decision-maker**, professionally point out what you noticed, then introduce your cleaning company and offer a solution.

The goal is NOT to bash their current cleaning company. The goal is to **show that you’re paying attention, identify a problem, and position your company as the solution.**

🔥 Want more strategies like this?

📺 Watch the **Cleaning Business Morning Show** every morning at **9 AM ET on YouTube @TenacityAcademy.**

⚔️ Trying to **START or GROW your cleaning business?**

Join **Tenacity Academy** and become a **Cleaning Business Warrior** today!

[www.tenacityacademy.com](http://www.tenacityacademy.com)

The reason your cleaning business **ain’t growing might be because it’s in the WRONG ENVIRONMENT.**

Think about it…

And it can grow into the **oak tree God intended it to become.**

Your BUSINESS is that seed.
